tests/engine/deck.test.ts 'invalid words and codes throw RangeError' passes on branch and fails on base; it asserts exact RangeError messages 'Invalid replay code: "0000000000..."' and '"0123456789..."'. Holdout confirms both messages via shuffledDeck.

findings.expected_vs_actual: A seats array with a hole (sparse array, e.g. first element missing) is not rejected by the shape guard: expected RangeError 'Invalid hand config' per A-1 ('a seat entry not a non-null object'); actual TypeError (cannot destructure 'seat' of undefined). Same as base and unreachable from JSON-restored data, so non-blocking.
findings.fix: Optionally treat missing seat entries (holes) as a shape failure so createHand throws 'Invalid hand config'.
